summary: Apply screen: click into a card to open the chunk view with its reviewed tags
description:
From the apply screen (POST /api/apply preview + confirm UI), the curator wants to click into a card and navigate to the chunk view showing that chunk's reviewed tags — for spot-checking verdicts before/after an apply.

Acceptance shape:
- Applied/preview cards are clickable and link to the chunk deck view for that chunk_id.
- The chunk view shows the chunk's tags WITH their review outcomes (accepted/rejected/reassigned status, reviewer, timestamp), not just pending ones.
- May need a read-side API addition if GET /api/chunks only surfaces pending tags today.

resolution.test_function: GET /api/chunks include_reviewed (todo:b72f6908) > omits reviewed_tags by default and includes them when requested
resolution.note: GET /api/chunks?include_reviewed=true adds reviewed_tags (status/reviewer/timestamp) per chunk; queue-screen tag/cleanup rows link to /?chunk=<id>, which focuses the deck on that chunk with the reviewed-verdict panel for spot-checking.
